title: Nourishing Indulgent Greek Korean Pear Tiropita
description: A fermented, fluffy, and indulgent Greek dish featuring Korean pear and rest meat, also vegan friendly, in the form of a tiropita.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced Korean pear to the skillet and cook until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pear, crumbled tofu, and crumbled feta cheese.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a quarter of the pear and cheese mixture onto the center of each phyllo piece.
Fold the phyllo into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the tiropita with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the tiropita for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
